sources.entry: ESMira - Run longitudinal studies (ESM, AA, EMA) with data collection and communication with participants being completely anonymous. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: ESMira is a free, open-source PHP web server and smartphone app pair for running longitudinal Experience Sampling Method (ESM/EMA/AA) studies with participant data collection and communication.
summary.what_it_does: ESMira is split into two parts: ESMira-web, the server where study administrators set up studies, communicate with participants, and store all study data, and ESMira-apps, the Android and iOS smartphone apps participants use to take part. The README says it is designed for simple setup on a standard webserver with PHP, so administrators can host it themselves rather than rely on third-party services. It is aimed at Experience Sampling Method (ESM), ecological momentary assessment (EMA) and similar repeated-measurement research designs. The README describes the project as decentralized and says it lets participant data collection and communication remain anonymous. Feature details are linked to the wiki and screenshots rather than listed in the README itself.
use_cases: run experience sampling studies with participants
collect repeated smartphone surveys for research
host a self-hosted research study platform
how_to_run: Copy the ESMira server files onto a webserver with PHP installed
Open the main ESMira page in a browser
Install the ESMira smartphone app (Android or iOS) for participants
notable: Two-part design: ESMira-web server for administrators and ESMira-apps for participants
Designed to be installed on one's own webspace, independent of third-party services
Supports Experience Sampling Method, EMA and AA study designs
Developed at Karl Landsteiner University, funded by the FWF
caveats: Requires a webserver with PHP; participants need the separate smartphone app
README does not state platform limits or hosting requirements beyond PHP
Users are asked to cite ESMira in publications
keywords: free alternative to hosted survey services
collect data from participants on phone
